title: Infer a partner's letter ordering from a sorted word list
insight: LeetCode 269 Alien Dictionary: adjacent word pairs give precedence edges between letters, then Kahn's topological sort picking the smallest ready letter; cycles and prefix violations are errors
prompt: We need InferOrder in order.go to reconstruct a partner's alphabet ordering from a word list they sorted with it. README.md is the contract: which order to return when several fit, what counts as an error, and the 100,000-word performance target. Keep the package name and exported signature as they are, standard library only, and ensure `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` are clean.
